name: 厄斯林
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:2918
who: Esslin, a long-lived demon-kin, high blood-oath priest of the seat of the demon-god Bain, about two thousand years old; his line ages slowly, yet a thousand years of blood oaths have worn him to look a little past forty: about 182 cm, tall and spare, elf-like, with a straight back. The long-lived line has NO horns, NO scales and NO tail: a smooth brow with nothing growing from the head, and faintly pointed ear tips, so strangers take him for an elf. Pale skin with a faint cool cast. Dark wine-red hair in one long braid hanging past the waist down his back. Pale gold eyes that glow faintly and steadily at night. On his left wrist (on the viewer's right when he faces us) old healed knife cuts lie ring over ring from the wrist bone up to the inside of the elbow, pale scar lines. A slow, grave air; he speaks as if reciting a prayer and crouches down to talk to children.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, grave man's face of a little past forty, NOT young: fine lines at the eye corners and two faint lines between the brows; pale gold, gently slanted almond eyes with a calm, steady gaze; straight dark wine-red brows; a straight narrow nose; a thin closed mouth; faintly pointed ear tips. Pale clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft cool tone. A smooth brow with NO horns.
build: 182 cm, tall and spare: narrow shoulders, long arms and long hands, a straight back.
palette: dark wine red, deep crimson washed pale, pale gold, bone white, old iron
casual: His priest's dress: a long deep-red priest's robe washed pale along the folds, closing down the front with buttons, with fitted sleeves, the left cuff turned back a little to show the scarred wrist; a plain dark leather belt with a single ritual knife in a worn leather sheath, the only thing he carries; plain dark boots. He stands straight with the hands loosely clasped in front, a slow, grave look.
private: On a cold night in the camp: the red robe taken off, a long-sleeved plain undyed wool tunic to the knees over dark trousers, soft boots, the braid over one shoulder. He holds the folded red robe over one arm as if about to wrap it around someone, a quiet, tired look.
battle: Before the altar in the last hour before dawn: the deep-red robe girded high with a dark leather sash, a long dark-red stole embroidered with rows of small blood-oath runes that glow a dull red, an enchanted leather bracer on the right forearm only, the left wrist bare and freshly cut, a thin thread of dark red light rising from the cut and winding up his arm. He holds the ritual knife raised in his right hand, its blade lit dull red, the left hand open at his side; faint hairline cracks of cold light hang in the air around him like a pane about to shatter. A calm, immovable look.
battle_pose: 3) the rite outfit: standing tall and planted, the ritual knife raised in the right hand and the cut left wrist held out with a thread of dark red light rising from it, faint cracks of cold light hanging in the air around him, a calm, immovable look; he is a priest and not a swordsman.
formal: Presiding over the feast: a long deep-red priest's robe of heavy wool, the hem and cuffs bordered with a band of small dark runes, a bone-white stole over the shoulders, the braid bound with a dark red cord, the ritual knife at the belt in a polished sheath. He stands very straight with one hand resting on the knife hilt, a grave, slow look.
art: A portrait from slightly above, the face large, as he crouches to the viewer's eye level, the pale gold eyes level and gentle, the mouth closed, as if telling a child it will hurt and he will not lie. Cold grey pre-dawn light from one side and warm torchlight from the other on his wine-red braid. Foreground blur: drifting ash, torch sparks and the corner of a child's sleeve cuff embroidered with tiny abstract stitch-marks, NOT readable letters. He wears the deep-red priest's robe.

name: 哈斯卡
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:2955
who: Haska, a demon-kin named one who pilots the largest siege colossus, called the Mountain-Presser by his camp, about four hundred and fifty years old and looking a little past forty: not tall, about 170 cm, with a thick chest, heavy shoulders and a broad back. Indigo hair shaved at both sides and gathered into one short tail at the back of the head. Silver-violet eyes. A pair of thick horns curving forward from above the temples; the right horn (on the viewer's left when he faces us) is broken off halfway, the stump bound with a ring of copper. On the inside of his left wrist (on the viewer's right when he faces us) a row of thin healed cuts, cut again and healed again. Fair skin with a faint cool ash cast. Strings of small drilled glass beads, rough and pale green like sand fused by fire, hang at his belt. He pauses a step to listen to the ground before he walks on. A short-spoken, counting, steady air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a broad, steady man's face of a little past forty, NOT young: lines at the eye corners; silver-violet medium almond eyes with a level, counting gaze; straight indigo brows; a short straight nose; a firm closed mouth. Fair skin with a faint cool ash tint and very little shading; skin shadows a soft cool tone.
build: 170 cm, compact and heavy: a thick chest, heavy shoulders and a broad back, strong short arms.
palette: indigo and silver violet, copper, pale sand-glass green, blood red, dark leather
casual: His camp clothes: a sleeveless dark leather jerkin over a dun linen shirt, the left sleeve rolled to the elbow to bare the cut forearm, dark trousers tucked into heavy boots, a wide belt hung with two strings of drilled glass beads and a small bone awl for drilling them. He holds one glass bead between finger and thumb, the head turned slightly as if listening to the ground, a quiet, counting look.
private: In his tent at the camp: a loose long-sleeved grey wool shirt, dark trousers, soft boots. He threads a new glass bead onto a cord held in both hands, the half-finished string hanging down, a calm, absorbed look.
battle: Climbing into the colossus: a padded dark leather pilot's coat strapped across the chest with a harness of thick belts for bracing against a lurch, an enchanted iron bracer on the right forearm etched with blood-oath runes, the left sleeve cut away and the left wrist bare and freshly cut, a line of blood-red rune light running from the cut up the forearm; strings of glass beads hang from the harness. He stands braced with the feet planted wide, the left arm thrust forward with the hand open and glowing red, the right fist closed around a glass bead, a hard, counting look; the colossus itself is NOT drawn.
battle_pose: 3) the pilot's outfit: braced with the feet planted wide as if the ground were lurching, the left arm thrust forward with the cut wrist glowing blood-red, the right fist closed around a glass bead, a hard, counting look; he carries no blade and no colossus is drawn.
formal: At a camp gathering before a great tide: a long dark leather coat with a stand collar and a row of iron buttons, a dark red sash, the copper ring on the broken horn polished, three long strings of glass beads worn across the chest from one shoulder. He stands upright with the hands at his sides, a grave, steady look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the silver-violet eyes looking at the viewer with a level, counting stare. He is inside the hollow chest of a siege colossus: walls of bone and iron carved with blood-oath runes glowing dull red behind him, many strings of glass beads hanging around him catching the red light. Foreground blur: hanging glass beads and drifting glittering sand. He wears the sleeveless leather jerkin with the cut left forearm bare.

name: 陶勒
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:2976
who: Taule, a white-bone demon-kin wolf-wright of the bone-wrights' guild who keeps the Bone Ridge on the western edge of the dead land, a hundred and seventy years old, in his prime and looking about forty: about 186 cm, tall and lean with long arms. Pale bone-grey skin with a faint cool cast; pale grey lines like carved bone patterns run across his cheeks and down his neck, the markings of the white-bone folk. A pair of short horns curving forward. Long indigo hair twisted into one rope hanging to the waist, an iron wolf's canine tooth tied at its end. Garnet-red eyes that look first at which leg a person stands on. Both forearms bleached chalk-white from wrist to elbow by bone dust. A short vertical old split in the middle of the lower lip, cracked open by blowing a bone whistle. The white-bone folk never sleep; he walks the ridge all night. A terse, restless air; he never stands still.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean man's face of about forty: garnet-red narrow almond eyes with a sharp, appraising gaze; level indigo brows; a straight nose; a thin mouth with a short vertical scar through the middle of the lower lip; pale grey carved-bone lines across the cheeks. Pale bone-grey skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft cool grey.
build: 186 cm, tall and lean: long arms and long legs, narrow hard shoulders.
palette: bone grey and chalk white, indigo, garnet red, pieced hide brown, dull iron
casual: His ridge clothes: a cloak pieced from several hides of the bone pack-beasts, the seams laced with sinew, over a fitted dark grey tunic with the sleeves pushed to the elbow to show the bone-white forearms, dark trousers and soft-soled boots worn thin; at his belt a bundle of his own bone tags on a cord and a short carving knife. In his right hand the whistle carved from a wolf's shin bone. He is caught mid-stride, a terse, watchful look.
private: At the guild workshop between watches: the hide cloak off, a loose long-sleeved grey wool shirt and dark trousers, soft boots, the hair rope over one shoulder. He holds a bone file and a jaw piece of bone and iron from one of his wolves, frowning at its teeth.
battle: Commanding the pack from the ridge: the pieced hide cloak thrown back, a short coat of iron-wolf plates riveted onto leather and cut with number marks, NOT readable text, enchanted bone bracers on both forearms etched with command lines glowing pale white, the bone tags rattling at his belt. He holds the shin-bone whistle to his lips with the right hand and the carving knife low in the left, mid-stride, a hard, intent look; no wolves are drawn.
battle_pose: 3) the wolf-wright's outfit: caught mid-stride as if he cannot stop walking, the shin-bone whistle held to his lips in the right hand, the carving knife low in the left, the hide cloak swinging, a hard, intent look; no wolves are drawn.
formal: At a gathering of the bone-wrights' guild: a long grey felt coat with a stand collar and a row of bone toggles, a sash of pale bone-white wool, the bone tags polished and hung neatly at the belt, the hair rope freshly bound with the wolf's tooth, the shin-bone whistle on a cord at his chest. He stands very straight, a grave, impatient look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the garnet-red eyes glancing back at the viewer over his shoulder as he walks, the shin-bone whistle held near his scarred lip. Cold blue night light along a white ridge of bones on one side, a faint red glow of iron wolves' eyes far behind. Foreground blur: blowing sand, a bone tag on a cord and the iron edge of a wolf's skull cut with marks, NOT readable text. He wears the pieced hide cloak.

name: 苔丝玛
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:2998
who: Tessma, a white-bone demon-kin, high blood-oath priest of the seat of the demon-god of crooked bones, a hundred and ten years old and looking a little past forty: about 166 cm, slight. Grey-white skin of the white-bone folk. Long, straight lead-blue hair falling to the backs of her knees, gathered at the back of the head with a clasp of strung, polished knuckle bones. Pale violet eyes. Every bone in her body healed crooked after she was crushed as a child: her right shoulder sits higher than her left, she drags her left foot half a step, and the five fingers of her right hand (on the viewer's left when she faces us) each bend a little off in a different direction, healed and whole, NOT bleeding and NOT broken open; she grips a knife with that hand steadier than anyone. A slow, grave air, speaking like a prayer; she looks at a person's bones before their face.
face: FACE, as in the references: a thin, grave woman's face of a little past forty, NOT young: fine lines at the eye corners; pale violet almond eyes with a slow, appraising gaze; thin lead-blue brows; a straight nose; a small closed mouth. Grey-white skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft cool grey.
build: 166 cm, slight and thin, the right shoulder higher than the left, the whole frame a little askew.
palette: bone white and grey-white, lead blue, pale violet, dark dried red, knuckle-bone ivory
casual: Her priest's dress: a long bone-white priest's robe closing down the front with bone toggles, with fitted sleeves, a narrow dark red cord at the waist, plain soft boots. She holds a short ritual knife in the crooked right hand, low and very steady. She stands a little lopsided with the weight on the right leg, a slow, appraising look.
private: In a quiet hour of a bell-city: a long-sleeved soft grey wool dress to the ankles, a knitted shawl, soft shoes, the lead-blue hair loose to the knees. She winds a linen bandage around a wooden splint held in her hands, a calm, careful look.
battle: On the rim of the pit, opening the blood oath: the bone-white robe girded with a dark red sash, a short mantle of pale felt sewn with rows of small bone tags, enchanted bone bracers etched with faint red runes. She holds the short ritual knife in the crooked right hand, a thin line of red light glowing across that palm, the left hand lifted open; around her faint lines of pale light twist askew like warped glass. A slow, immovable look.
battle_pose: 3) the rite outfit: standing lopsided and immovable, the short ritual knife held steady in the crooked right hand with a thin line of red light across that palm, the left hand lifted open, faint lines of pale light twisting askew around her, a slow, grave look; she is a priest and not a soldier.
formal: Presiding at the feast of a bell-city: a long bone-white robe of heavy wool with a high collar fastened with bone toggles, a dark red stole embroidered with small bone shapes, the knuckle-bone clasp in her hair, a string of small bell-shaped bone beads at the chest, the ritual knife at the waist. She stands lopsided but straight-backed with the hands folded, a grave look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale violet eyes looking at the viewer as if checking how your bones were set, the crooked right hand raised near her face with the fingers bent each its own way, a short knife held steady in it. Cold grey dusk light from one side, a faint dull red glow from below. Foreground blur: drifting ash and the edge of a whitewashed bell tower. She wears the bone-white priest's robe.

name: 柏莎
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:3017
who: Bertha, a demon-kin horn-priestess of the seat of the Horn That Calls Back, a hundred and seventy years old and looking a little past thirty: about 172 cm, slender. Iris-violet hair, very long, bound into one tail with bone rings and hanging to the backs of the knees. Salt-white eyes, the irises pale almost to white. A pair of horns sweeping from behind the ears and curving forward, the tips turned toward the mouth and flared open like two small trumpet bells. A short vertical old split in the middle of the lower lip, worn by the mouthpiece. Fair skin with a faint cool cast. Over her shoulders a patchwork cloak pieced from many families' old blankets, each patch a different weave and colour. Her horn is longer than she is tall: a great bone-white war horn curving in one arc, its bell opening upward. A warm, calling air; she asks everyone how many are at home.
face: FACE, as in the references: a woman's face of a little past thirty: salt-white almond eyes with very pale irises and a warm, searching gaze; thin iris-violet brows; a straight nose; a closed mouth with a short vertical scar through the middle of the lower lip. Fair skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft cool tone.
build: 172 cm, slender, with strong shoulders and a deep chest from a lifetime of blowing the horn.
palette: iris violet, salt white, bone white, patchwork of faded red, ochre and grey-green, dark leather
casual: Her camp dress: a long dark wool dress with long fitted sleeves, a dark leather belt, soft boots, and over it the patchwork cloak of old family blankets fastened at the throat with a bone pin. She holds the great bone-white horn upright beside her in both hands, its bell above her head, a warm, searching look.
private: Resting between calls: a loose long-sleeved grey-green wool dress to the ankles, a shawl, soft shoes, the violet hair loose. She holds out a water skin in one hand, the great horn cradled in the crook of the other arm, a tired, kind look.
battle: On the horn-altar in the dead land: the patchwork cloak thrown back over the shoulders and belted, a fitted dark leather bodice over the dress with enchanted bone plates at the shoulders etched with pale glowing call-lines, leather bracers. She raises the great bone-white horn to her lips with both hands, the bell flung high, the bell-shaped tips of her own horns glowing pale. A fierce, unbroken look.
battle_pose: 3) the horn-priestess's outfit: standing braced with the feet planted, the great bone-white horn raised to her lips in both hands with its bell flung up, the eyes fierce, the patchwork cloak streaming behind; she carries no blade.
formal: At a night of calling the dead home: a long dark wool robe with long sleeves and a stand collar, the patchwork cloak brushed clean and pinned with bone, the hair freshly bound with polished bone rings, a small wooden bowl tied at her belt on a cord. She stands upright with the great horn held upright at her side, a grave, gentle look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the great bone-white horn at her lips, the salt-white eyes looking at the viewer over its curve. Behind her the huge pale ribs of a fallen god's skeleton arch into a dusky sky, and grey shadow-shapes of people stand in rows below the altar, all facing her. Cold violet dusk light from one side. Foreground blur: wooden bowls tied to tent poles swaying and drifting grey ash. She wears the patchwork cloak of family blankets.

name: 劳里·铃尾
src: 纷争纪/纷争纪时段_六_铁狼的年月.md:3039
who: Lowry Belltail, a beast-eared scout and map-maker of the Bell-tail scout band at the southernmost tip of the great wall, forty-three: about 176 cm, thin, his back a little stooped. Short navy-blue hair with the temples already white. Verdigris-green eyes. A pair of narrow, long beast ears standing upright on top of the head, navy like his hair; the left ear (on the viewer's right when he faces us) has a notch missing from its edge. A slender tail with a small brass bell tied at the tip, as the Bell-tail clan wear. Both hands stained with ink that never washes off. After the last expedition, rows of small tattooed marks run along his left forearm (on the viewer's right), thirty-eight names in an invented script, NOT readable letters, several struck through, and thin inked lines of a route are pricked up his right forearm (on the viewer's left). A quiet, spare air; he measures ground in steps before he looks at people.
face: FACE, as in the references: a thin, worn man's face of forty-three: lines at the eye corners; verdigris-green almond eyes with a quiet, measuring gaze; straight navy brows; a straight nose; a closed, sparing mouth; white hair at the temples. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft cool tone.
build: 176 cm, thin and wiry, the back a little stooped, long legs for walking.
palette: navy blue and white, verdigris green, scout grey, ink black, brass
casual: His scout's clothes: a plain grey short tunic of the scouts with the cuffs and trouser legs bound tight, a short grey leather jerkin with a coil of rope looped across the back, soft short boots soled with thin copper, an old scouts' blanket wrapped round his shoulders; a flat leather map case at the hip and a thin knotted pacing cord on the belt; a small ink bottle on a cord tucked under the collar against his chest. The brass bell on his tail. He holds a pen and a sheet of map paper, looking down at his own steps.
private: In the scouts' house by the gate tunnel, after he came back: a loose long-sleeved grey wool shirt with the left sleeve rolled to show the tattooed marks, dark trousers, soft shoes, the blanket over his shoulders, thinner than before. He holds a dry pen in his ink-stained fingers, silent, a quiet, faraway look.
battle: Over the line into the dead land: the grey scout tunic bound snug, the grey leather jerkin with enchanted brass plates at the shoulders etched with faint warding lines that glow pale blue, copper-wired cuffs, the blanket tied on his back like a pack, the map case strapped across his chest. He holds a short knife in the right hand, its tip dark with ink, and a brass winding key on a cord in the left; one long measured step forward, ears up, a steady, intent look.
battle_pose: 3) the scout's outfit: one long measured step forward, the ears up and turned, the ink-dark short knife low in the right hand and a brass winding key held in the left, a steady, intent look; he is a map-maker, not a swordsman.
formal: For a roll-call at the gate: a clean grey scout's tunic with the sleeves and trouser legs bound with new cord, a dark blue sash, a small sewn ring badge on the shoulder, the folded blanket over one arm, the brass tail bell polished. He stands straight with the map case held against his chest, a quiet, grave look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the verdigris-green eyes looking at the viewer, quiet and sparing, the mouth closed. He holds up his left forearm near his face, its rows of tattooed marks, several struck through, NOT readable letters. Cold grey light of the dead land on one side, warm firelight from a gate tunnel on the other. Foreground blur: a drop of ink, the tip of a knife and drifting grey sand. He wears the grey scout tunic with the blanket over his shoulders.
